-111.75200,33.29640.name: New Direction Fertility Centers

Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

106.73000,-6.56000.name: Indonesian Agency for Agricultural Research and Development
106.73000,-6.56000.desc: Indonesia’s agricultural research agency, for a country of 280 million that is a centre of diversity for rice, banana and spices and the world’s largest palm oil producer. Decisions taken here affect more people and more land than most of the national bodies on this map, and reach English-language discussion almost never.

-77.04160,38.84840.name: Reporting an incident — the duty on the permit holder
-77.04160,38.84840.desc: Permit conditions require the holder to notify the regulator when something goes wrong — material found outside the site, a containment failure, a mislabelled shipment — usually within days. It is self-reporting, which means it works when the holder tells and not otherwise. Most of the unauthorised releases on record were found by somebody else and reported afterwards, which is the argument for the monitoring in Guide 1 rather than an argument about anyone's honesty.
